title: The security manager authorises
summary: Proposals run under ooRexx Routine~setSecurityManager. METHOD (any protected call): the policy decides from principal, class, method (or authorityAction, e.g. Workspace~run is run:make) and authorityPath; a path through a symbolic link is denied before any rule. COMMAND/CALL/STREAM/REQUIRES: denied for llm, allowed and logged for console. LOCAL/ENVIRONMENT: llm only ARRAY SHELLCOLLECTION TRUE FALSE NIL ENDOFLINE. Every decision is a ShellDecision receipt (verdict, principal, kind, target, path, rule) and an AUTH log line. Policy: etc/newshell.policy, verdict principal class method path, first match wins, no match denies, paths match on / boundaries, method* is a prefix. Trusted shell classes run unchecked: the objects do the I/O, the proposal only asks.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Run proposals under the security manager and have it perform the authorisation (Tom Dyer, 2026-11-24)
Console lines run as principal console under the same policy
procedure: To allow a new capability: make the method PROTECTED, give authorityPath, add one policy line
